Random Forests, Tree by Tree.zh: 随机森林：逐棵树地理解

Bagging + random feature sampling — the.zh:
Bagging + 随机特征采样——最简单却仍能在半数场合取胜的表格数据集成方法。
          逐棵添加树；观察决策边界变得平滑、OOB 误差下降、特征重要性
          趋于稳定。在同一数据集上把 RF 与纯 bagging、Extra-Trees 进行比较。
Bagging + random feature sampling — the.src:
Bagging + random feature sampling — the simplest tabular
          ensemble that still wins half the time. Add trees one at a
          time; watch the boundary smooth, OOB error fall, feature
          importance stabilise. Compare RF to bagging-only and
          Extra-Trees on the same dataset.

@@T0@@~16 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Cla.zh:
@@T0@@约 16 分钟@@T1@@
          @@T2@@经典机器学习 · 集成方法 · Bagging@@T3@@

The variance-reduction argument in two l.zh: 两行说清方差缩减的论证
The variance-reduction argument in two l.src: The variance-reduction argument in two lines

A single deep tree is high-variance: sma.zh: 单棵深树具有高方差：训练集上的微小扰动会大幅改变划分点。若我们有 $T$ 棵树，两两相关系数为 $\rho$，每棵树的方差为 $\sigma^2$，则平均预测的方差为
A single deep tree is high-variance: sma.src: A single deep tree is high-variance: small training perturbations move splits a lot. If we have $T$ trees with pairwise correlation $\rho$ and per-tree variance $\sigma^2$, the variance of the average prediction is

Two terms: an irreducible part driven by.zh: 它由两项构成：一项由树间相关性驱动、不可消除；另一项为 $1/T$，由独立性驱动。@@T0@@Bagging@@T1@@ 通过让每棵树在不同的自助样本上训练来降低 $\rho$。@@T2@@随机特征子采样@@T3@@ 进一步迫使不同的树在不同特征上划分，从而降低 $\rho$。二者的结合正是随机森林稳定性的来源：$T \to \infty$ 使 $\sigma^2/T$ 项趋于零，而残余项 $\rho\sigma^2$ 远小于 $\sigma^2$。
Two terms: an irreducible part driven by.src: Two terms: an irreducible part driven by between-tree correlation, and a $1/T$ part driven by independence. Bagging lowers $\rho$ by training each tree on a different bootstrap sample. Random feature subsampling lowers $\rho$ further by forcing different trees to split on different features. The combination is what makes a random forest stable: $T \to \infty$ drives the $\sigma^2/T$ term to zero, and the residual $\rho\sigma^2$ is much smaller than $\sigma^2$.

A single deep tree is unbiased-ish but v.zh: 单棵深树近似无偏但方差很大；对数百棵这样的树求平均可保持偏置并压平方差。这就是所有 bagged 集成方法背后的全部直觉。
A single deep tree is unbiased-ish but v.src: A single deep tree is unbiased-ish but variance-heavy; averaging hundreds of them keeps the bias and crushes the variance. This is the entire intuition behind every bagged ensemble.

A single deep decision tree is high-vari.zh:
单棵深决策树具有高方差——训练集上的微小扰动会大幅改变划分点。
          随机森林（Breiman，2001）对许多这样的树求平均，
          并通过两个技巧使每棵树与其余树去相关：
A single deep decision tree is high-vari.src:
A single deep decision tree is high-variance — small
          training-set perturbations move the splits a lot.
          Random Forest (Breiman, 2001) averages many such trees, each
          de-correlated from the others by two tricks:

@@T0@@Bagging.@@T1@@ Each tree sees a bo.zh:
@@T0@@Bagging。@@T1@@ 每棵树看到的都是训练数据的一个自助样本
            （有放回抽样，规模与原数据相同）。约 63% 的不重复样本点
            会出现在每个自助样本中；其余 37% 即该树的
            @@T2@@袋外（out-of-bag）@@T3@@ 样本——每棵树都免费获得一个
            留出集。
@@T0@@Bagging.@@T1@@ Each tree sees a bo.src: Bagging. Each tree sees a bootstrap sample of the training data (sampled with replacement, same size as the original). About 63% of unique points appear in each bootstrap; the other 37% are the out-of-bag samples for that tree — a free held-out set per tree.

@@T0@@Random feature subsampling.@@T1@@.zh:
@@T0@@随机特征子采样。@@T1@@ 在每次划分时，
            只有 $d$ 个特征中的 $m$ 个有资格被选中。默认值：分类任务 $m = \sqrt d$，
            回归任务 $m = d/3$。它迫使不同的树关注不同的特征，
            效果优于仅对特征做 bagging。
@@T0@@Random feature subsampling.@@T1@@.src: Random feature subsampling. At each split, only $m$ of the $d$ features are eligible to be picked. Defaults: $m = \sqrt d$ for classification, $m = d/3$ for regression. Forces different trees to look at different features and beats bagging-on-features-alone.

Extra-Trees (Geurts et al., 2006) goes f.zh:
Extra-Trees（Geurts 等，2006）更进一步：在每次划分时，
          以@@T0@@随机@@T1@@方式而非最优方式选取阈值。它以略增偏置
          换取更大的方差缩减；在信号丰富的数据上往往略差，
          在噪声数据上则略好。
Extra-Trees (Geurts et al., 2006) goes f.src: Extra-Trees (Geurts et al., 2006) goes further: at each split, pick the threshold randomly rather than optimally. Trades a little bias for even more variance reduction; often slightly worse on signal-rich data, slightly better on noisy data.

Click @@T0@@Add tree@@T1@@ to add one tr.zh:
点击 @@T0@@添加树@@T1@@ 以逐棵添加树。
          森林预测的类别是其各棵树的多数投票结果。
          决策边界在前 10 棵树时迅速变平滑，此后逐渐平缓。
          仅当树的数量 $\ge$ 3 时才报告 OOB 误差。
Click @@T0@@Add tree@@T1@@ to add one tr.src: Click Add tree to add one tree at a time. The forest's predicted class is the majority vote of its trees. The boundary smooths quickly in the first 10 trees and gradually after that. OOB error is reported only once $\ge$ 3 trees exist.

Random Forest (m via slider).zh: 随机森林（m 由滑块控制）

OOB error + feature importance, tree by.zh: OOB 误差 + 特征重要性，逐棵树呈现
OOB error + feature importance, tree by.src: OOB error + feature importance, tree by tree

OOB error — the free held-out set.zh: OOB 误差——免费的留出集
OOB error — the free held-out set.src: OOB error — the free held-out set

Each training point is \"out-of-bag\" fo.zh:
对约 37% 的自助样本未包含该点的树而言，每个训练点都是“袋外”的。
          要得到它的 OOB 预测：仅在这些树上投票。OOB 误差即
          所有训练点使用各自 OOB 预测得到的误分类率。
Each training point is \"out-of-bag\" fo.src:
Each training point is "out-of-bag" for the ~37% of trees
          whose bootstrap didn't include it. To get its OOB
          prediction: vote across just those trees. The OOB error is
          the misclassification rate over all training points using
          their respective OOB predictions.

Properties: (1) no leakage; (2) you don'.zh:
其性质为：(1) 无信息泄漏；(2) 调参时无需划分训练/测试集；
          (3) 随着树的数量增加，收敛到真实的测试误差。
          第 2 步中的 OOB 曲线应与留出测试曲线的走势在噪声范围内一致。
Properties: (1) no leakage; (2) you don'.src:
Properties: (1) no leakage; (2) you don't have to split into
          train/test for tuning; (3) converges to the true test error
          as trees grow. The OOB curve in Step 2 should match the
          slope of a held-out test curve within noise.

Feature importance — three ways, none pe.zh: 特征重要性——三种方法，皆非完美
Feature importance — three ways, none pe.src: Feature importance — three ways, none perfect

@@T0@@Mean decrease in impurity (MDI).@@.zh:
@@T0@@不纯度平均下降量（MDI）。@@T1@@ 把某个特征
            在每棵树的每次划分中所贡献的不纯度下降量求和，再归一化。
            速度快，但对高基数特征有偏。
@@T0@@Mean decrease in impurity (MDI).@@.src: Mean decrease in impurity (MDI). Sum up the impurity drop a feature contributed at every split in every tree; normalise. Fast, biased toward high-cardinality features.

@@T0@@Permutation importance.@@T1@@ Shuf.zh:
@@T0@@置换重要性。@@T1@@ 在 OOB 集中打乱某个特征；
            测量 OOB 准确率的下降幅度；下降越大表示越重要。
            无偏，但计算代价高。
@@T0@@Permutation importance.@@T1@@ Shuf.src: Permutation importance. Shuffle one feature in the OOB set; measure the drop in OOB accuracy; larger drop = more important. Unbiased, expensive.

@@T0@@SHAP / TreeSHAP.@@T1@@ Per-predict.zh:
@@T0@@SHAP / TreeSHAP。@@T1@@ 具备 Shapley 值保证的
            逐预测贡献。解释 RF / boosting 预测的现代标准方法。
@@T0@@SHAP / TreeSHAP.@@T1@@ Per-predict.src: SHAP / TreeSHAP. Per-prediction contributions with Shapley-value guarantees. The standard modern way to explain RF / boosting predictions.

MDI is what the live demo shows. Always.zh:
实时演示展示的是 MDI。在真实数据集上务必用
          置换重要性交叉验证——MDI 可能把某个随机噪声的高基数特征
          标记为“重要”。
MDI is what the live demo shows. Always.src:
MDI is what the live demo shows. Always cross-check with
          permutation importance on real datasets — MDI can flag a
          random-noise high-cardinality feature as "important".

What RF is good at — and what trips it u.zh: RF 擅长什么——以及它会在哪里栽跟头
What RF is good at — and what trips it u.src: What RF is good at — and what trips it up

@@T0@@Strengths.@@T1@@ Mixed-type tabula.zh:
@@T0@@优势。@@T1@@ 混合类型的表格数据、
            特征众多、交互作用温和、对离群点稳健、
            能处理缺失值、可并行训练、可用 OOB 调参。
@@T0@@Strengths.@@T1@@ Mixed-type tabula.src: Strengths. Mixed-type tabular data, many features, mild interactions, robust to outliers, handles missing values, parallel training, OOB tuning.

@@T0@@Weaknesses.@@T1@@ Extrapolation ou.zh:
@@T0@@劣势。@@T1@@ 在训练范围之外的推断
            （构造上即为零）；平滑的低维回归（高斯过程更好）；
            类别高度不平衡（应使用类别加权采样）；极高维稀疏
            （XGBoost / LightGBM 往往更优）；无法高效地捕捉
            旋转后的决策边界。
@@T0@@Weaknesses.@@T1@@ Extrapolation ou.src: Weaknesses. Extrapolation outside training range (zero by construction); smooth low-dim regression (a GP is better); highly imbalanced classes (use class-weighted sampling); very high-dim sparse (XGBoost / LightGBM tend to win); cannot capture rotated decision boundaries efficiently.

@@T0@@Where it sits in 2026.@@T1@@ Still.zh:
@@T0@@它在 2026 年的地位。@@T1@@ 对任何
            能用 10 行 sklearn 代码处理的表格任务而言，它仍是默认的首选。
            若想再提升一轮准确率，可改用 @@T2@@XGBoost /
            LightGBM@@T3@@ 并调参。若需要概率输出，
            可用@@T4@@保形预测@@T5@@包装，或使用 NGBoost。
@@T0@@Where it sits in 2026.@@T1@@ Still.src: Where it sits in 2026. Still the default first-try on any tabular task you can throw 10 lines of sklearn at. If you want one more lap of accuracy, switch to XGBoost / LightGBM and tune. If you need probabilistic outputs, wrap with conformal prediction or use NGBoost.

@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n Wisdo.zh:
@@T0@@口号。@@T1@@
          群体智慧，但群体中的每个成员看到的是世界的不同侧面。
          其背后的数学只有一行
          （对独立同分布的弱学习器求平均可把方差降低为 1/n）；
          其实践含义是：只要能训练五十棵决策树，就绝不要只训练一棵。
@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n Wisdo.src: The slogan. Wisdom-of-crowds, but each crowd-member sees a different slice of the world. The math behind it is one line (averaging i.i.d. weak learners reduces variance by 1/n); the practical implication is that you should never train one decision tree when you can train fifty.

RF vs Gradient Boosting — when to use wh.zh: RF 与梯度提升——何时使用哪一种
RF vs Gradient Boosting — when to use wh.src: RF vs Gradient Boosting — when to use which

Trees are sequential (later trees fix ea.zh: 各树依序训练（后续树修正先前树的错误）
Trees are sequential (later trees fix ea.src: Trees are sequential (later trees fix earlier mistakes)

Sensitive — must tune learning rate, max.zh: 敏感——必须调节学习率、max_depth、正则化项
Sensitive — must tune learning rate, max.src: Sensitive — must tune learning rate, max_depth, regulariser

Slightly better, still wrap with Platt /.zh: 略好，但仍需用 Platt / isotonic 包装
Slightly better, still wrap with Platt /.src: Slightly better, still wrap with Platt / isotonic

Many features, mild signal, fast prototy.zh: 特征众多、信号温和、快速原型开发
Many features, mild signal, fast prototy.src: Many features, mild signal, fast prototyping

Tight accuracy targets, large datasets,.zh: 准确率目标严苛、数据集庞大、Kaggle 竞赛
Tight accuracy targets, large datasets,.src: Tight accuracy targets, large datasets, Kaggle

Mental model: @@T0@@RF averages many tra.zh: 思维模型：@@T0@@RF 对许多从零训练的树求平均；boosting 则在一系列小树上依次拟合彼此的残差。@@T1@@ 关于 boosting 的机制，参见 @@T2@@XGBoost 一文@@T3@@。
Mental model: @@T0@@RF averages many tra.src: Mental model: RF averages many trained-from-scratch trees; boosting trains a sequence of small trees on each other's residuals. See the XGBoost article for boosting's mechanics.

Increase until OOB error plateaus; cheap.zh: 增加到 OOB 误差趋于平稳为止；收益廉价，且不会过拟合。
Increase until OOB error plateaus; cheap.src: Increase until OOB error plateaus; cheap upside, no overfit.

Cap at 10–15 if memory matters; small ef.zh: 若内存受限则限制在 10–15；对准确率影响较小。
Cap at 10–15 if memory matters; small ef.src: Cap at 10–15 if memory matters; small effect on accuracy.

Lower for redundant features; raise for.zh: 特征冗余时调低；特征稀疏 / 微弱时调高。
Lower for redundant features; raise for.src: Lower for redundant features; raise for sparse / weak features.

Raise to 5 if labels are noisy; smoother.zh: 标签含噪时提高到 5；决策边界更平滑。
Raise to 5 if labels are noisy; smoother.src: Raise to 5 if labels are noisy; smoother boundary.

Set False to disable bagging (then OOB i.src: Set False to disable bagging (then OOB is undefined).

@@T0@@-1@@T1@@ to use all CPU cores — em.src: -1 to use all CPU cores — embarrassingly parallel.

meta.title: 随机森林：逐棵树地理解
meta.tagline: Bagging + 随机特征采样——为何由弱树组成的森林能胜过单棵强树
meta.summary: 在一个二维分类问题上，观察树如何一棵棵加入森林；决策边界逐渐平滑，袋外误差逐步收敛，特征重要性柱状图趋于稳定。把纯 bagging、RF（= bagging + 随机特征）与 Extra-Trees 并排比较；调整 n_estimators 与 max_features，实时观看偏置-方差权衡的展开。
highlights: 点击“添加树”，逐棵树地观察森林决策边界如何变平滑。
随树加入实时追踪 OOB 误差；它收敛到无需另设留出集即可获得的测试误差。
在同一数据集上并排比较纯 bagging、RF 与 Extra-Trees。
特征重要性柱状图 + 偏依赖面板，使“为何做出这一预测”有了诚实的答案。
